scope: The 2 admitted X509_VERIFY_POLICY production obligation(s) in src/x509/v3_pci.rs that the enumerated SSH closure reports as reachable but without an owning boundary receipt are enumerated here for ownership only, at their census coordinates, with a hazard read from each function. This receipt claims no discharge, no contract and no new reachability finding.
non_claims: This receipt does not discharge any site, and no site may be treated as discharged on its authority.
This receipt does not contract any site; the hazard notes are enumeration notes, not established contracts.
This receipt does not assert reachability; reachability is taken from the enumerated closure and is not re-established here.

boundaries.hazard: Raw PROXY_CERT_INFO_EXTENSION is dereferenced; pathlen, policyLanguage and policy bytes are printed with the policy text length taken from the ASN.1 string.
NUL-terminated value is parsed into a CONF_VALUE stack and section names are looked up in the live X509V3_CTX; any failure returns NULL after partial cleanup.
